# P3 Compass — Data Directory

This directory contains pre-built JSON data files synced from P2 Meridian.

**Do not edit these files manually.** They are generated by:

```bash
python3 scripts/sync_p2_data.py
```

## Structure

```
data/
├── dashboards/          # One subdirectory per dashboard
│   ├── visa-bulletin/   # fact_cutoff_trends.json, fact_cutoffs_all.json
│   ├── employer/        # employer_friendliness_scores.json, etc.
│   ├── eb-category/     # category_movement_metrics.json
│   ├── geographic/      # worksite_geo_metrics.json
│   ├── wage/            # salary_benchmarks.json
│   ├── soc-demand/      # soc_demand_metrics.json
│   ├── processing/      # processing_times_trends.json, etc.
│   └── backlog/         # backlog_estimates.json, etc.
├── dims/                # Dimension lookups
│   ├── dim_country.json
│   ├── dim_soc.json
│   ├── dim_area.json
│   ├── dim_visa_class.json
│   ├── dim_visa_ceiling.json
│   └── dim_employer.json
├── models/              # Model outputs
│   ├── pd_forecasts.json
│   └── pd_forecast_model.json
├── rag/                 # RAG chunks + QA cache
│   ├── all_chunks.json
│   ├── qa_cache.json
│   ├── catalog.json
│   └── build_summary.json
└── _manifest.json       # Build metadata & file sizes
```
